bodyHub.faqSubtitle: Find answers to common questions about body contouring procedures
bodyHub.faq0A: Body contouring is a term used to describe treatments that shape specific areas of the body by targeting stubborn fat or loose skin, often after weight loss.
bodyHub.faq1Q: Does body contouring mean the same thing as weight loss surgery?
bodyHub.faq1A: No. Body contouring does not help you lose weight. It is a technique that focuses on improving proportions and shaping after the weight has stabilized.
bodyHub.faq2Q: Who is body contouring suitable for?
bodyHub.faq2A: Body contouring can be used by people who have reached their ideal weight, but are still bothered by some areas of the body that don't respond to diet and exercise.
bodyHub.faq3Q: Does my weight need to be ideal before I can have body contouring done?
bodyHub.faq3A: The best thing to do is to maintain a weight that is close to your ideal. Weight changes that are large after surgery may affect the results.
bodyHub.faq4Q: What body contouring procedure do I need?
bodyHub.faq4A: It is not necessary to make a decision on your own. Consultation helps to determine if skin tightening or fat removal is the best option.
bodyHub.faq5Q: Do I need liposuction or a tummy tuck?
bodyHub.faq5A: Liposuction can be helpful if the primary concern is excess fat. A tuck or a lift may be recommended if loose skin is the primary concern. Many patients require a combination that is personalised.
bodyHub.faq6A: Yes. Body contouring can be done to achieve a smooth, balanced result that fits your natural body shape.
bodyHub.faq7A: The fat removed will not return. However, the results are dependent on maintaining a healthy weight and lifestyle.
bodyHub.faq8Q: Can multiple areas of the body be treated at once?
bodyHub.faq8A: Some patients may need to treat more than one part, depending on the patient's health and safety. This is discussed in consultation.
bodyHub.faq9Q: Is body contouring a safe procedure?
bodyHub.faq9A: All surgical procedures are not without risk. Safety is dependent on a thorough assessment, expert surgical planning and proper aftercare.
bodyHub.faq10Q: How will body contouring affect the fit of my clothes?
bodyHub.faq10A: After contouring, many patients report improved comfort and fit of clothing.
bodyHub.faq11Q: What if I'm not sure if I'm ready for surgery?
bodyHub.faq11A: This is perfectly fine. Consultations can only be for information, and not to pressure you into anything.
bodyHub.faq12Q: Does body contouring work only on women?
bodyHub.faq12A: No. Both men and women can benefit from body contouring, depending on their goals and anatomies.
bodyHub.faq13Q: What is the first step to begin body contouring?
bodyHub.faq13A: First, you will need to have a consultation with a professional in order to determine your goals and concerns. You should also know what is realistic and safe for your body.
